rulings.evidence: Grated is a knife/microplane instruction, not a form: this is fresh ginger root, deliberately NOT ground-ginger (dried powder, different price class and gram weight). Follows the 2026-08-26 'fresh ginger' -> fresh-ginger precedent; board 6 of 7. The parenthetical frozen cubes are a substitution note, not the ingredient.
